business_thesis: Q1 FY27 showed broad operating acceleration: consolidated revenue grew 25% YoY, PAT grew 47%, Advanced Materials revenue grew 85%, and garment volume grew 13%. The Sep 11 H020 development screen still classified ARVIND as PAPER_ENTRY_ELIGIBLE_TREND despite a bearish market regime, while current valuation is meaningful but not in the extreme range seen in several other high-growth candidates. This is a development-book test of the complete analyst-to-PF001 pipeline, not independent validation evidence.

catalysts.description: Q2 FY27 result and whether Advanced Materials/garment growth remains broad-based

invalidations.condition: Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue growth falls below 10% year-over-year
valuation expands materially without corresponding forward earnings upgrades

missing_information: No valid H021 28-35 day EPS-revision comparison exists before 2026-10-09.
H019 point-in-time accounting-quality signal is not yet available for this decision.
ARVIND was used during H020/PF001 design discussion and is therefore development-only, not PF001 validation evidence.

base.narrative: Revenue/PAT growth moderates but remains healthy, relative strength persists, and valuation stays near the current forward multiple.

bear.narrative: Advanced Materials growth normalizes sharply, consolidated growth slows, or valuation compresses in the weak market regime.

bull.narrative: Advanced Materials and garment growth remain strong, earnings expectations rise, and the stock sustains relative strength as the market regime improves.
